STRICT DRAWING STYLE: clean flat transparent acrylic layers in side profile, paper-white background, solid ink contour, no pencils, desks, notebooks, pipes, physical levers or props. Main desktop contains ONLY a foreground pointer and one drawn blue leaf shape on white; ZERO texts/lines resembling document writing. Behind it, isolated window contains two cut-paper silhouettes of the same leaf in cool blue and warm amber. Live preview repeats both leaves to show the source’s batch-color-grading example. Flat optical glass joins these views. For approval depict a closed seam before a key action, and a separate seam opened only by the 'Approve key action' event. Do not literalize this into a crank or switch. Keep only the eight preapproved labels. No scenic image, no photo, no line filling, no extra explanatory writing.
Create one beautiful professional technical-book editorial illustration with white paper, 1200 by 630 landscape. Architectural cross-section of a quiet foreground desktop plane over a separate, inset agent workspace. Selected app access bounds the region. An inspection window lets a reviewer see the pending action, pause the process and grant approval to a key action. The desktop pointer remains on the independent foreground plane. Use tactile etched glass and sparse colored pencil, no icons from real products. Use Side-on architectural section and Indigo and coral. Depict only the source facts: Gemini works inside an isolated background window with a live preview right in your chat. Your main screen and cursor remain completely free. You choose accessible apps, can pause at any time and approve key actions. Preserve very large print labels with a 72 px inset; source detail on every meaningful surface. Required visible text exactly once each: Main desktop | Isolated window | Allowed apps | Live preview | Pause | Approve key action | Task continues | User grants access. Draw only the named connections at object ports, separate caveat, no caption strip, no badge wall, no other text or frame. Geometry below is for art direction and must never appear printed.
